note: Digest pins for every external tool. Phase 0 needs only TLC. Verifier images land in Phase 1 (Gobra) and Phase 2/3 (OpenJML, JBMC).

verus.note: not on PATH by default; z3 4.12.5 ships alongside it

gobra.status: RESOLVED -- full digest read from the local image's RepoDigests; version and revision read from its own OCI labels, not from documentation
gobra.platform_note: linux/amd64 only. On arm64 hosts docker emulates it and prints a platform-mismatch warning; verification results are unaffected.
gobra.required_env_reason: The JVM in this image crashes reading cgroup v2 container metrics. Disabling container support makes it size the heap from the host instead. Without it the run dies before Gobra starts.
gobra.host_mount: $HOME/.viper must exist and be mounted at /root/.viper; create it with mkdir -p before the first run.
gobra.stubs: impls/go/stubs (errors, log, sort, sync) -- vendored from the upstream Go repo; -I /work/stubs masks Gobra's built-in sync spec, so both Mutex and RWMutex are re-declared there

tlc_container.verified: TLC2 2.19 launches inside it; the jar is bind-mounted read-only
tlc_container.note: Optional. The sha256-pinned jar is the determinism lever, not the JVM. Container JVM is 21, host is 17 -- TLC 2.19 runs on both, and a disagreement between them would itself be worth knowing.
